silures.translation: [复]n.志留人(在罗马征服时期居住在威尔士东南部的一个古代不列颠人部落)

silurian.definition: n. from 425 million to 405 million years ago; first air-breathing animals

silurian period.translation:
un. 志留纪
[网络] 志留利亚纪

silurid.definition: n Old World freshwater catfishes having naked skin and a long anal fin more or less merged with the eellike caudal fin

siluridae.translation: [网络] 鲶科；鲇科；鲶五大淡水湖科

siluriformes.translation: [网络] 鲶形目；鲇形目；鲶目

siluroid.definition:
n. Belonging to the Siluroidei, or Nematognathi, an order of
   fishes including numerous species, among which are the American
   catfishes and numerous allied fresh-water species of the Old World, as
   the sheatfish (Silurus glanis) of Europe.
n. A siluroid fish.

siluroidei.definition: n. pl. An order of fishes, the Nematognathi.

silurus.definition:
n. A genus of large malacopterygious fishes of the order
   Siluroidei. They inhabit the inland waters of Europe and Asia.
